stories.headline: Houthis claim attack on Saudi Arabia's largest oil refinery
stories.summary: The group said it hit Ras Tanura and warned all Saudi Red Sea ports were targets.

stories.headline: Judges urge dropping key Netanyahu bribery case
stories.summary: Israeli judges said conviction chances were low and suggested a plea deal instead.

stories.headline: Poland to create no-fly zone near Ukraine border
stories.summary: Warsaw acted after airspace incursions it blamed on Russia.

stories.headline: Ukraine says it needs 115 billion euros for 2027
stories.summary: Zelensky said the EU had pledged about 90 billion euros so far.

stories.headline: Shenzhou-24 docks at Tiangong with first foreign astronaut
stories.summary: Pakistan's Muhammad Zeeshan Ali is the first non-Chinese visitor to the station.

stories.headline: Solomon Islands and Australia sign treaty barring foreign bases
stories.summary: The pact would preclude a foreign military or security base on the islands.

stories.headline: US proposes new tariffs on 14 economies
stories.summary: Rates of 20 to 40 percent were proposed; nothing takes effect before a hearing.

stories.headline: Huawei found guilty in US trade-secrets trial
stories.summary: A jury convicted Huawei of fraud and theft; it was cleared of racketeering.

stories.headline: RSF drone strikes kill 19 in Sudan's Blue Nile state
stories.summary: At least 19 were killed and 20 wounded in Damazin and Roseires, monitors said.

stories.headline: At least 30 killed in fuel vehicle fire near Cairo
stories.summary: A petroleum vehicle overturned and caught fire on a ring road; 27 vehicles burned.

stories.headline: Bangladesh raises garment wage 36 percent after protests
stories.summary: The minimum monthly wage rises to 17,000 takas; workers had sought 30,000.

stories.headline: Colombia rescues all hostages in Cartagena supermarket siege
stories.summary: Forces stormed the store, freed the remaining hostages and killed one captor.

lead.headline: Tankers hit mines in Strait of Hormuz as US-Iran war widens
lead.source: Reuters via Just Security Early Edition, 25 Nov 2026; Daily Summary Of, 25 Nov 2026
lead.summary: Two oil tankers struck naval mines and caught fire in the strait, Iran's Revolutionary Guard said. The US told its citizens to leave Iran at once.

lead_extra.headline: US tells citizens to leave Iran after attacks in Bahrain, Kuwait and Riyadh
lead_extra.summary: Washington warned US interests could be targeted and hostilities could escalate fast.

lead_extra.headline: Saudi coalition says it hit Hodeidah port after Houthi threats
lead_extra.summary: The coalition said it struck the Yemeni port and targets in Saada and Amran.

more.headline: Rescuers search for miners trapped in flooded gold mine in West Java
more.summary: Dozens were unaccounted for after a river overflowed into the shaft.

more.headline: North Korea orders Swiss office in Pyongyang to close
more.summary: Pyongyang expelled the Swiss envoy and gave him 48 hours to leave.

more.headline: UK warns firms of Russian sabotage threat
more.summary: Defence and MI5 warned Ukraine supporters of arson attempts by proxies.

more.headline: Iraq court lets Baghdad deploy troops to borders
more.summary: The top court backed federal control over crossings and oil in Kurdish areas.

more.headline: Wall Street slides as AI sell-off deepens
more.summary: The S&P 500 fell about 2.2 percent and the Nasdaq about 3.2 percent at midday.

more.headline: Pope Leo calls COP31 failure troubling
more.summary: He said the climate talks ended without clear commitments to act.

more.headline: WHO chief urges US to lift Cuba fuel blockade
more.summary: Tedros said fuel curbs were harming health care and putting children at risk.

more.headline: Ebola workers evacuated in DR Congo
more.summary: UN staff were rescued after sheltering three days in a hospital in Ituri.
